turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I'm Meredith Kalinowski, Owen's mother. I have a client call at 4:40, so I don't have long. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen spoken to before it went in?
Thanks for coming in. I want to walk through the version history.
Version history of what, Hale? You haven't told me what document you're talking about or where it came from. Show me what you have.
612 words in one edit at 11:52 PM, then 794 more at 11:58 PM.
Which night, and who pulled that history? Procedure 4.2 says I get a call before any mark goes in, and nobody called me.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL

Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require the zero withdrawn, an apology to Owen, and written confirmation that nothing goes on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF

Where she ended: Opening position, with nothing agreed, so she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and a written promise that nothing goes on his record, and she is heading to the principal. That is not yet the fair outcome, which would be a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and time did not run out.
What moved her: Nothing. The edit times were specific, but you gave no date, no source, and no way for her to check them, so they could not shift her.
What cost ground: Starting with the version history before owning that the zero went in before anyone called her, and never answering who decided or whether Owen was heard first. That left her free to attack the process, which is where she is strongest.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked. Your edit times of 11:52 PM and 11:58 PM came close to that kind of late night, though you gave no date, and that is why she went short and straight to procedure. It proves nothing about the essay; it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: Open with one sentence owning that the zero went in before you called her, then give the date and where the version history came from so she can check it herself.
Redo the debrief as a table please.
